caption: The drawing depicts three fireplace tools arranged vertically within a rectangular border: a pair of tongs on the left, a central andirons or fire fork, and a shovel on the right. The tongs and shovel both have blackish handles and working ends, with light brown wall mounts featuring rounded ends and decorative plates, each mounted with a knob and hook for hanging. The central object, a fire fork or andiron, is primarily colored in shades of brass with a spherical top and a cylindrical shaft that splits into two prongs at the bottom. The detailing shows shading and highlights, giving the appearance of reflective metal, particularly on the brass-colored surfaces. The bottom left and near the center of the composition contain small linear scale diagrams with markings, and the lower right holds the signature "HANS KORSCH." The overall drawing uses pencil or ink lines for contours and shading, with localized use of yellow and brown tones on metal parts and grayscale for the iron pieces. The background is off-white and untextured.
title: Fire Tongs, Shovel, and Jamb Hooks
